name: nhtsa_vpic-mcp
description: NHTSA vPIC (VIN decoder) (automotive): decode_vin. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: Decode VIN (flat format), GET /vehicles/DecodeVinValues/{vin}?format=json. Partial VINs are accepted with '*' for unknown characters. raw.ErrorCode/ErrorText carry NHTSA's decode notes ('0 - VIN decoded clean'); a VIN whose make cannot be decoded is an error with NHTSA's ErrorText.
